records.source_statement: Seventh lord in ascendant is read as the desired party loving most.
First lord in seventh is read as querent loving most.
Seventh lord in seventh, especially own house, is interpreted as the desired partner little inclined to marriage.
limitations: Different from seventh lord in first.

records.source_statement: Quesited significators not beholding querent significators are read as another love or aversion.
limitations: Two alternate readings, not proof of infidelity.

records.source_statement: Frustration of a completing application is associated with marriage prevented by the planet causing it.
Read a frustrating planet's house rulership and location for the attributed cause of obstruction.
limitations: The rule is conditional on an identified frustrating planet.

records.source_statement: Second-house ruler helping transfer or collect light is said to represent a dowry or financial helper.
limitations: This is mediation, not the independent money-shortfall obstruction.
